decision: Selected HostDime Colombia's own schema.org GeoCoordinates for its LocalBusiness 'HostDime Colombia — Data Center Nebula' (latitude 4.9631492, longitude -73.9616311), published in the JSON-LD of the operator's Data Center Nebula page together with the facility address (Km 1.5 vía Briceño–Zipaquirá, Vereda Verganzo, Zona Franca de Tocancipá, Interior 9, Tocancipá, Cundinamarca), copied as published, as the project locator. The same page also carries an embedded Google Maps iframe whose parameters hold the same two values; the iframe was not read for the locator and no map service was queried. IGAC's public cadastral layers were used only to check that the point falls inside a Tocancipá (DANE 25817) rural cadastral parcel near the free-zone access road; they do not identify the data-centre building.

conversion: None. Schema.org GeoCoordinates are WGS84 decimal degrees; the values are copied as published (7 decimals) and stored as [longitude, latitude].
map_embed_disclosure: The page's location section embeds a Google Maps iframe (www.google.com/maps/embed) whose pb parameters contain !2d-73.9616311 and !3d4.9631492 and the place name 'HostDime Colombia Data Center Nebula'. These equal the JSON-LD values, so the operator's structured-data coordinate and its embedded map pin very likely share an origin. The locator is taken from the operator's structured data, which the locator-source rule accepts; the iframe, its place identifier and any Google page were not fetched or used.

igac_r_terreno.note: Exactly one R_TERRENO parcel contains the point. Its code begins 25817, the DANE code of Tocancipá, consistent with the operator address. The parcel (about 38.7 ha) is far larger than the data-centre building, carries no address or owner in the public layer, and is not used as the locator.

igac_r_construccion.note: No cadastral construction contains the point. The nearest, 29.2 m away, is a 978 m2 one-storey construction on the same parcel. None of the recorded constructions within 200 m has five storeys, so the public cadastral layer does not appear to show the five-storey, 6,400 m2 Nebula building that the free-zone operator described, and it cannot confirm or refine the building position; the cadastral layer carries no currency date.

caveat: The point is HostDime's facility reference coordinate for Data Center Nebula with no stated method or accuracy (schema.org GeoCoordinates are WGS84). It is not a surveyed footprint, entrance or parcel centroid. Because it matches the page's embedded map pin, it may mark the place listing rather than the building centre; the building footprint is not published by the operator or in the public cadastral layer, so the offset to the building is unknown (the nearest recorded construction is 29 m away).
